threshold_metadata.scope: Derivation and justification of concrete numeric thresholds for Tier 2 review AV1 releases from 32 consolidated ledger rows
threshold_metadata.governance_notice: Specification artifact only. Zero modifications to active profiles, tiers, scores, Custom Formats, Radarr/Profilarr configuration, release restrictions, download rules, media files, or live automation.

vmaf_mean_minimum.rationale: 90.0 VMAF ensures perceptual parity with high-quality 2160p BluRay encodes, weeding out severely softened or pre-filtered releases.

vmaf_min_floor.rationale: 85.0 minimum scene floor specifically prevents localized catastrophic collapses (e.g. Fury 66.77, John Wick 1 68.61, Blade Runner 74.55).

mbps_minimum_2160p.rationale: 2160p AV1 encodes below 8.0 Mbps consistently suffer from macroblocking in dense grain and near-black mist gradients.
